data.body: [INFO][risk:high] Exact-range security checklist. This target exposes, but does not introduce, a HIGH availability RED: an execute-capable agent can submit a Budget with every field absent; budget::ceilings_of treats all dimensions as unbounded (crates/continuumd/src/daemon/budget.rs:107-114), bounds_after selects Bounds::CERTIFIABLE (202-214), and only states is metered (94). verification.start runs the exploration synchronously through Server::answer (crates/continuumd/src/transport/mod.rs:777-816). The target records this honestly and bn-1wu3w tracks the production repair. Failure modes: one request can consume up to 2^20 states, 2^20 depth, and 2^22 transitions; repeated distinct tasks can amplify CPU and memory use because the declared max_concurrent_tasks has no enforcement path. Edge cases: empty objects, omitted states, explicit ceilings on unmetered wall/cpu/memory dimensions, unique task identities, and resumed or updated budgets need fail-closed coverage. Rollback: reverting this target would only restore false coverage; an operational rollback must revoke execute access or disable verification.start until quotas exist. Monitoring: attribute accepted starts, active tasks, explored states, wall time, RSS, and absent ceilings by capability, with quota alerts. Validation: the changed test distinguishes five states from all-absent and pins the current RED; bn-1wu3w must add a large-model refusal, repeated-start quota tests, and every budget-dimension case. Static review only; no tests were run under the reviewer write boundary. No target-introduced security blocker.

data.reason: Informational risk:high checklist. The baseline availability RED is tracked in bn-1wu3w; this target adds accurate evidence and no product behavior.
